name: Silo Complex
description: A pre-war agricultural facility repurposed as a fortified compound. The broadcast signal originates from somewhere inside. The Iron Covenant has a strong presence here. Whatever is transmitting, they're guarding it.

interactables.label: Broadcast Antenna
interactables.text: A jury-rigged transmission array bolted to the silo roof. The signal has been looping for months — maybe longer. Whoever started it is long gone. Or they're still here.

ambient_description: The hum of old machinery. Static. The broadcast — distorted but unmistakable — echoing from somewhere below.
